title: Second–fourth names: Jah, Eheje, El
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): Ye SECOND name JAH is (Exodus 15:2; Psalms everywhere), by which unto praising GOD one another they exhorted. Ye THIRD EHEJE is (Exodus 3:13-14), God's absolute existence plus necessity denoting. Ye FOURTH name EL is (Isaiah 9:6), God's fortitude plus power signifying.
pass_b_english: The SECOND name is JAH (Exodus 15:2; Psalms everywhere), by which they exhorted one another to praise GOD. The THIRD is EHEJE (Exodus 3:13-14), denoting God's absolute existence and necessity. The FOURTH name is EL (Isaiah 9:6), signifying God's fortitude and power.
source_text: SECUNDUM nomen est JAH, Exod. 15.2; Psal. passim, quo se invicem ad DEUM laudandum exhortabantur. TERTIUM est EHEJE, Exod. 3.13.14, denotans absolutam Dei exsistentiam & necessitatem. QUARTUM nomen est EL, Esai. 9.6, significans fortitudinem & potentiam Dei.
